name: Paper Target Backers
short_description: Heavy paper target backers.
description:
National Target’s paper target backers deliver heavyweight support for precision shooting at 50 feet, 50 yards, and 100 yards/meters. These heavy paper backing targets provide a professional foundation for scoring targets while protecting range equipment and improving bullet hole clarity. Ideal for indoor ranges, training facilities, and competition venues requiring clean, consistent target presentation.

Material: Heavy paper stock engineered for durability and clean bullet penetration

Available Sizes & Distances:

  • 10.5″ × 12″ (50 Foot)
  • 14″ × 16″ (50 Yard/Meter)
  • 14″ × 28″ (100 Yard/Meter)

Construction: Dense paper composition provides firm backing surface while maintaining flexibility for easy mounting and storage

Pack Size: 100 sheets per pack

Professional Grade: Heavy paper construction balances performance with cost-efficiency for high-volume shooting operations

Enhanced Target Definition: Heavy paper backing ensures scoring targets punch cleanly, delivering crisp bullet holes essential for accurate evaluation and competitor scoring

Equipment Longevity: Paper target backing sheets absorb impact energy, reducing wear on target frames and extending the life of range infrastructure

Practical Design: Lighter than cardboard alternatives while maintaining structural integrity, making them easier to transport and store in bulk quantities

Cardboard vs Paper Backers

Choose Paper Backers When:

  • Running precision competitions requiring clean scoring and minimal target distortion
  • Working with standard NRA-sized targets at 50ft, 50yd, or 100yd/m distances
  • Need easier transport and storage for mobile training operations
  • Prefer lighter-weight backing that’s simpler to mount and replace quickly

Choose Cardboard Backers When:

  • Need maximum durability for high-volume range use and repeated sessions
  • Protecting expensive range infrastructure is the primary concern
  • Working with larger tactical silhouettes or non-standard target sizes
  • Require rigid backing that won’t shift or flutter in outdoor conditions

Both options deliver professional results: paper excels at precision scoring applications, while cardboard backers provide maximum protection and versatility across target types.

Feature Specification
Use Target backing for pistol, rifle, and air gun shooting
Material Heavy paper stock
Pack Size 100 sheets
Size Options 3 distance-specific sizes: 50ft, 50yd, 100yd/m
Weight Heavyweight construction for durability
Applications Competition backing, training support, range protection

Paper target backers from National Target offer shooters and range operators a reliable, cost-effective solution for maintaining professional standards across all shooting disciplines, from NRA-sanctioned matches and law enforcement qualifications to competitive training sessions.

description:
RIFLE DOT-TORTURE – Multi-Circle Precision Training Target

The Rifle Dot-Torture target is a specialized precision training tool featuring ten numbered 4-inch circles designed to challenge shooters’ accuracy and consistency across multiple aiming points. This target format eliminates the advantage of consecutive shots and forces shooters to reset their sight picture for each shot, making it ideal for developing fundamental marksmanship skills and testing rifle precision.

Physical Specifications

Size: 20″ × 25″ – generous format accommodating all ten circles with clear spacing

Material: NRA-grade lightweight paper in buff color for optimal contrast and bullet hole visibility

Design Features: Ten distinct 4-inch circles numbered 1-10, each providing a separate aiming point to prevent shot-to-shot reference advantages

Packaging & Pricing

Pack Size: 100 targets per pack for extended training sessions

Material Benefits: Buff-colored paper stock provides excellent contrast against dark bullet holes while maintaining durability for accurate scoring

✅ Use Cases

Precision Development: Each numbered circle requires a fresh sight picture, preventing shooters from using previous shots as reference points and building true marksmanship fundamentals

Versatile Training Tool: Suitable for various rifle disciplines including precision shooting, hunting preparation, and marksmanship skill assessment

Progress Tracking: Numbered circles allow for systematic scoring and performance evaluation, making it ideal for training progression documentation

Challenge-Based Training: Forces consistent shooting technique across multiple targets, revealing weaknesses in form, breathing, and trigger control

short_description: Langdon Tactical Pistol Skills target
description:
LTT-1

Lightweight Paper – Natural
Size: 18″ X 25″

Priced per 100

 

The Langdon Tactical Pistol Skills target was designed to allow shooters and firearms instructors to shoot several drills and or several relays without having to change targets.  The design is a collaboration between Ernest Langdon and John M. from the LA Sheriff’s SEB team.  The 2″ dots are there to provide fundamental accuracy drills that can be run at closer distances.  The 2″ dots can also be used for standard multiple-shot trigger control drills.  The B-8 Bull’s Eye also provides an 8″ circle area by using the 8 ring.  This can be used to provide a larger aiming area for speed work at closer distances as well as a large aiming area for drills like “3, 2,1”.  The 4″ circle with the 1″ square in the middle provides the additional aiming areas for “3,2,1” as well as making a great zero target even for scoped rifles and red dot optics.  Your imagination is the only limit with this target and it is easy to get in a several hundred round practice session without changing targets.
